title: [Riso] Timeslot - Inactive Timeslot - Edit lesson already assigned to it - Timeslot still shown as selected in Edit form
description: AC US02.4 - Regression + Negative: A lesson keeps showing its existing Timeslot in the Edit form after that Timeslot is deactivated; only new selection of an inactive Timeslot is blocked. Found 2026-10-08: the Edit form currently shows the Timeslot field blank because the dropdown only loads Active Timeslots — this case is expected to fail until fixed.
preconditions:
- Partner config "Show Timeslot In Lesson" is ON
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Salesforce with Lesson edit permission
- Timeslot Master "Morning" (09:00 ~ 10:00) was Active when Lesson P1 was created
- Lesson P1 at Location A is dated 2026-10-21 09:00 - 10:00 and has Timeslot "Morning"
- Timeslot Master "Morning" has since been set to Active = false (Inactive)
steps_actions:
1. HQ or CM Staff opens Lesson P1 detail in Salesforce
2. HQ or CM Staff clicks Edit on Lesson P1
3. HQ or CM Staff looks at Start Time and End Time in the Edit form
4. HQ or CM Staff opens Lesson Calendar for Location A on 2026-10-21, clicks Lesson P1 and opens the Edit popup
steps_result:
1. Lesson P1 detail shows Timeslot "Morning"
2. The Edit form opens; the Timeslot field shows "Morning (09:00 ~ 10:00)" as the selected value (not blank)
3. Start Time = 09:00 and End Time = 10:00
4. The Edit popup opens; the Timeslot field shows "Morning (09:00 ~ 10:00)" as the selected value (not blank)
steps_data:
1. today = 2026-10-20; lesson_date = 2026-10-21; Morning = Inactive
2. expected selected = Morning
3. unchanged times
4. surface = Lesson Calendar Edit popup; lesson_date = 2026-10-21

title: [Riso] Timeslot - Inactive Timeslot - Edit lesson and save without touching Timeslot - Timeslot value retained on the lesson
description: AC US02.4 - CRUD (update) + Regression: Saving the Edit form of a lesson whose Timeslot is inactive must not clear or replace the Timeslot. Found 2026-10-08: the Edit form currently shows the Timeslot field blank because the dropdown only loads Active Timeslots — this case is expected to fail until fixed.
preconditions:
- Partner config "Show Timeslot In Lesson" is ON
- HQ or CM Staff is logged in to Salesforce with Lesson edit permission
- Timeslot Master "Morning" (09:00 ~ 10:00) was Active when Lesson P1 was created
- Lesson P1 at Location A is dated 2026-10-21 09:00 - 10:00 and has Timeslot "Morning"
- Timeslot Master "Morning" has since been set to Active = false (Inactive)
- Lesson P1 has Lesson Name "Math P1"
steps_actions:
1. HQ or CM Staff opens Lesson P1 in Salesforce and clicks Edit
2. HQ or CM Staff changes Lesson Name to "Math P1 updated", does not touch the Timeslot field and clicks Save
3. HQ or CM Staff reopens Lesson P1 detail
4. HQ or CM Staff clicks Edit on Lesson P1 again and clicks Save without any change, then reopens Lesson P1 detail
steps_result:
1. The Edit form opens
2. The lesson is saved without error
3. Lesson Name = "Math P1 updated"; Timeslot still shows "Morning"; time is still 09:00 - 10:00
4. Timeslot still shows "Morning"
steps_data:
1. today = 2026-10-20; Morning = Inactive
2. only Lesson Name changed
3. expected Timeslot = Morning (retained)
4. second save, no change
